description: Hand-made inventory of testable PRD statements, used only to score the INTERPRET step's recall. Each phrase is a verbatim PRD fragment; a statement counts as covered when some extracted requirement's prd_quote contains it.

items.phrase: opens the demo dashboard without requiring a password
header identifies the active demo customer
logging out returns the user to the landing page
direct navigation to them should return the user to the landing page
refreshing while in a valid demo session should preserve that session
must not regain access merely by refreshing
dashboard shows the customer's checking and savings accounts
masked account identifier, account type, and current available balance
balances are displayed to two decimal places
must not expose a full account identifier
opens an account detail view
must agree with the latest successful transactions
transfer funds between the checking and savings accounts
includes source account, destination account, amount, and an optional memo
same-account transfers must be rejected
no more than two digits after the decimal point
must not exceed the source account's available balance
a valid transfer is atomic
creates one completed transfer record
reports success only after the transfer has been committed
refreshing after a successful transfer must preserve
combined transaction history and account-specific history
each row shows date and time
amount direction should be clear
every displayed row must satisfy all selected filters
start and end dates are inclusive
must show a clear empty state
clearing filters restores the unfiltered history
displays only synthetic demo-customer details
must not reveal passwords, authentication tokens
remains usable at narrower widths
interactive controls have readable labels
should not silently disappear
lead to the labeled destination
a recoverable error must leave the user able to retry
one customer, one checking account, one savings account
